businessRequirements.statement: Sequence Number has six ASCII digits.

sourceEvidence.quote: Representation: Fixed length of six digits

businessRequirements.condition: A transaction carries Element 86; this representation does not prove sequence allocation or uniqueness.

businessRequirements.statement: Associated follow-up retains the original authorization sequence.

sourceEvidence.quote: Sequence Number must persist in all the subsequent transactions that are associated with the initial authorization request.

businessRequirements.condition: An independently eligible follow-up is associated with an initial authorization; original sequence is supplied.

businessRequirements.statement: EMV Card Sequence Number occupies three ASCII bytes.

sourceEvidence.quote: Representation: Fixed length of three bytes, right-aligned and padded with zeroes

businessRequirements.condition: Applicable ICC transaction containing Element 188; this is width only, not tag agreement or cryptographic validity.

businessRequirements.statement: Credit processing performs expiration validation.

sourceEvidence.quote: The device performs expiration date validation in a credit card transaction.

businessRequirements.condition: Electronic credit processing under section 10.1; excludes debit and separately governed product profiles.

businessRequirements.statement: Non-Amex credit defaults to Track 2.

sourceEvidence.quote: For all other card types, the default track should be Track 2.

businessRequirements.condition: Section 10.1 electronic credit magnetic-stripe initial transaction; device supports readable Track 2; not EMV or a follow-up.

businessRequirements.statement: Unreadable Track 2 falls back to unaltered Track 1 before manual entry.

sourceEvidence.quote: If the device cannot read Track 2, then the device should send unaltered Track 1 on the initial transaction, before attempting manual entry.

businessRequirements.condition: Initial non-Amex electronic credit magnetic-stripe transaction; Track 2 unreadable, Track 1 readable.

businessRequirements.statement: Amex MSR/MSD AFD carries Track 1.

sourceEvidence.quote: Track 1 data is mandatory for all (both MSR and MSD) Amex AFD transactions

businessRequirements.condition: Amex AFD using MSR or MSD; not a universal entry-mode requirement.

businessRequirements.statement: Encrypted Amex AFD selects Track 1 as encryption target.

sourceEvidence.quote: Track 1 data must be present inside the Encryption Block with Encryption Target as Track 1.

businessRequirements.condition: Amex AFD contains encrypted data in the TransArmor Encryption Block; Track 1 content separately checked.

businessRequirements.statement: Partial-approval credit reversal uses the approved amount.

sourceEvidence.quote: The amount in a Reversal (Void) request must be the amount approved in the original transaction response when a transaction has been partially approved.

businessRequirements.condition: Network supports partial approval; original partially approved response and eligible reversal are supplied. Not TOR.

businessRequirements.statement: Credit authorization reversal preserves the approval number.

sourceEvidence.quote: must be present and identical in the Authorization Only Reversal transaction.

businessRequirements.condition: Eligible section 10.1.2.2 POS/CAT Authorization Only Reversal; original approval number present; field identity as named in this clause requires review against element catalog.

businessRequirements.statement: Standard Interlink PIN-debit does not allow manual entry.

sourceEvidence.quote: Manual entry is not allowed on a debit card transaction.

businessRequirements.condition: Transaction is independently classified under section 10.2 PIN-debit processing; do not apply to Signature Debit or PINless profiles.

businessRequirements.statement: Applicable PIN-debit encrypts the PIN using DUKPT.

sourceEvidence.quote: it must be encrypted using the DUKPT PIN encryption method.

businessRequirements.condition: Section 10.2 PIN entry is required; excludes Purchase Reversal PIN exception; method label is not cryptographic proof.

businessRequirements.statement: A received debit completion response stops retries.

sourceEvidence.quote: Any response from BUYPASS to a Debit Card Completion transaction should end attempts to retry a Debit Card Completion

businessRequirements.condition: BUYPASS response received for a Debit Card Completion, whether approved or declined.

businessRequirements.statement: Interlink cashback merchants support Partial Approval.

sourceEvidence.quote: Interlink requires that merchants supporting cashback must also support Partial Approval transactions.

businessRequirements.condition: Merchant supports Interlink cashback; not proof every card or transaction permits cashback.

businessRequirements.statement: Partially approved PIN-debit TOR uses approved amount.

sourceEvidence.quote: The amount in a TOR request must be the amount approved in the original transaction response when a transaction has been partially approved.

businessRequirements.condition: Eligible section 10.2 partially approved debit transaction; not a debit Completion TOR.

businessRequirements.statement: STAR Signature Debit settlement currency is USD 840.

sourceEvidence.quote: The transaction must be settled only in US Dollar (840)

businessRequirements.condition: Confirmed STAR Signature Debit single- or dual-message processing; routing and US/territory requirements separately reviewed.

businessRequirements.statement: STAR Signature Debit excludes cashback.

sourceEvidence.quote: Cash back is not supported

businessRequirements.condition: Confirmed STAR Signature Debit single- or dual-message profile.

businessRequirements.statement: STAR Signature Debit excludes eCommerce.

sourceEvidence.quote: eCommerce transactions, including those using 3-D Secure Protocol, such as Verified by Visa, MC Secure code transactions, Amex SafeKey and Discover ProtectBuy are not supported

businessRequirements.condition: Confirmed STAR Signature Debit single- or dual-message profile; source states eCommerce is not supported.

businessRequirements.statement: STAR single-message transactions cannot be keyed.

sourceEvidence.quote: The transactions cannot be keyed

businessRequirements.condition: Confirmed STAR Signature Debit single-message processing; do not extend to generic Signature Debit.

businessRequirements.statement: STAR single-message final amount matches authorization.

sourceEvidence.quote: Transactions must have the final amount same as the original authorization amount

businessRequirements.condition: Confirmed STAR Signature Debit single-message authorization and associated final transaction.

businessRequirements.statement: Visa incremental authorization retains initial sequence.

sourceEvidence.quote: Contains the same Sequence Number as the estimated or initial transaction request.

businessRequirements.condition: Permitted merchant and eligible Visa Appendix AE incremental transaction; initial authorization supplied.

businessRequirements.statement: Visa incremental authorization retains initial transaction identifier.

sourceEvidence.quote: Contains the same Transaction Identifier in Segment as the estimated or initial transaction request.

businessRequirements.condition: Eligible Appendix AE incremental; logical identifier supplied; source omits segment number so wire placement remains unresolved.

businessRequirements.statement: Visa incremental retains initial terminal transaction number.

sourceEvidence.quote: Contains the same Terminal transaction number (Table ID 63 in Segment 111) as the estimated or initial transaction request.

businessRequirements.condition: Eligible Appendix AE incremental authorization with supplied original Table 63 terminal transaction number.

businessRequirements.statement: Visa incremental follows an initial authorization.

sourceEvidence.quote: Only follows an estimated / initial authorization.

businessRequirements.condition: Eligible Appendix AE incremental lifecycle; ordered logical transaction roles, not wire messages.

businessRequirements.statement: Visa lodging, cruise and car-rental window remains anchored to initial authorization.

sourceEvidence.quote: will expire 14 days after the initial estimated authorization.

businessRequirements.condition: Permitted cruise, lodging or car/vehicle rental merchant; elapsed calendar days from initial, not latest incremental; timestamp/timezone cutoff unresolved.

businessRequirements.statement: Visa other-rental window is seven days from initial authorization.

sourceEvidence.quote: will expire seven days after the initial estimated authorization.

businessRequirements.condition: Permitted other-rental merchant, such as trailer park or campground; elapsed calendar days; not an exhaustive MCC mapping or timestamp cutoff.

businessRequirements.statement: Discover IA transactions carry Segment 111 Table 82.

sourceEvidence.quote: All IA transaction types should contain Incremental Auth Data (Variable Information segment 111 Table 82). This is mandatory for Discover.

businessRequirements.condition: Discover Appendix AF Original Auth, Incremental Auth, IA Reversal or IA Completion; not all ordinary Discover transactions.

businessRequirements.statement: Discover subsequent IA transactions follow Original Auth.

sourceEvidence.quote: Incremental Auths, IA Reversals, and IA Completions are all subsequent transactions, and must be preceded by an Original Auth.

businessRequirements.condition: Eligible Appendix AF logical lifecycle; no host approval or merchant permission inferred.

businessRequirements.statement: Discover subsequent IA preserves approved Original Auth approval code.

sourceEvidence.quote: Subsequent IA transactions must contain the Approval Code (DE 39) that was received on the approved Original Auth.

businessRequirements.condition: Original Auth approved; subsequent IA transaction independently eligible; response-derived approval supplied.

businessRequirements.statement: Discover IA completion closes subsequent activity for that terminal transaction ID.

sourceEvidence.quote: Once an IA Completion is received, the IA is closed, and no more subsequent transactions will be approved for that Terminal Transaction ID.

businessRequirements.condition: Ordered roles for one supplied Terminal Transaction ID; completion received; cross-ID allocation and host responses not simulated.
